audit_items.proof_trace: Trust boundary bypass assumes EL is JWT-authenticated, but auth.rs:96-98 returns Ok(None) when no JWT secret is configured. If Grandine runs without --el-auth-jwt-secret and attacker MITMs the CL-EL connection, malicious blobs bypass KZG/inclusion verification. The is_from_el() check doesn't verify that authentication was actually enforced.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker configures Grandine without JWT secret, performs MITM on localhost CL-EL connection, injects malicious ExecutionLayer-sourced blobs that skip cryptographic verification, potentially causing consensus violations.
